data.one_liner: Dart library for changing String case style to the desired convention.
data.what_it_does: Provides casing utilities to convert strings between different conventions like camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, dot.case, constantCase, titleCase, lowerCase, and upperCase. Handles various input formats including digits and symbols.
use_when: You need to format strings into camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, or other conventions.
You are processing raw text inputs that use mixed casing styles.
avoid_when: You need heavy natural language processing or full localization support.
strengths: Supports a wide variety of case styles.
Handles multiple input formats and edge cases like digits and symbols cleanly.
